data.name: Nowhere Highway
data.detailed_description:
Nowhere Highway is an atmospheric single-player Survival FPS set one year after a global catastrophe. An underground energy pulse of incredible power scorched nearly the entire surface of the planet. Only isolated patches of land were spared, and for unknown reasons, all of them are located along an old mountain highway that once connected small towns far from major cities. You will embark on a dangerous journey, exploring the post-apocalyptic world on foot and by car, discovering locations that still hold the remnants of a lost civilization.

Interaction with the World

Every action in the game has a cost, every decision has consequences, and a single problem may have multiple solutions. You choose your own survival strategy and character development path, while a random event system makes each playthrough unique, adding an element of unpredictability. You don't just exist in this world; you constantly interact with it, and it reacts to you.

True Freedom of Exploration

One of the core rules of the game is simple: if you see a door, you can go through it. From lonely roadside diners to apartment buildings in abandoned ghost towns, every structure is open for exploration. Items lie exactly where their owners left them on their last ordinary day. Every interior tells a silent story of the people who once lived there. There is no meaningless, randomly scattered loot. The world is logical and believable, meaning an attentive explorer will always be rewarded.

Character Development

Adaptability is the key to survival. The world changed after the catastrophe, and to survive, you will have to change too. The game offers a diverse character development system that allows you to grow to suit your chosen playstyle. There are no magical skill trees. Instead, you must find books to gain knowledge, use exercise equipment in abandoned homes, and hone specific skills to unlock new interactions with the environment.

Hardcore Survival

The game won't hold your hand: there are no navigation markers, quest indicators, or pop-up hints. Your main tools are observation and the ability to plan ahead. You'll need to explore this world on your own, learn its rules, and face the consequences of your decisions.

data.short_description: Atmospheric Single-player Survival FPS. Explore a post-apocalyptic world one year after a global catastrophe. Uncover the story of a mysterious mountain highway that connects the last remaining patches of life. Explore the world, fight for survival, and push forward along the highway.
